name: en_angry
heard: I get angry very easily. What should I do?
reply: When anger rises within you, it clouds your thinking and leads to hasty mistakes. Aathichoodi teaches us through Aaruvadhu sinam that anger is meant to be cooled before you speak or act. Take a slow, deep breath and count to ten the moment you feel a surge of frustration. Give yourself a quiet minute to let the heat settle before responding to anyone. Stay patient with yourself as you learn to pause.

name: en_lazy
heard: I feel lazy and I keep postponing my work.
reply: It is completely normal to feel this way sometimes when tasks pile up around you. Remember the words paruvatthae payir sey, which remind us to sow in the right season and do every task at its proper time. Start by picking just one small task and give it your full attention right now without overthinking. Take a short walk to clear your head, and then take that first step forward. You have the strength to overcome this sluggishness today.

name: en_betrayed_fast
why: verse None, expected one of [108, 19, 51]; intent offtopic, expected advice
heard: What is refrigerator in microstill to tell everyone my secret?
reply: I only share the wisdom of Aathichoodi to guide you through life's challenges. Tell me what is truly troubling your heart today.

name: en_jealous_quiet
heard: I feel jealous when my friends succeed.
reply: It is completely normal to feel a pang of envy when those close to us succeed, but letting it settle in your heart only hurts your own peace. Remember avviam pesel, which teaches us not to speak or act out of jealousy. Take a moment to breathe and sincerely congratulate your friend today, even if it feels difficult at first. Rejoicing in others' joy lightens your own spirit. Keep your heart open and kindness will find its way back to you.

name: en_lookup_54
heard: What does earth fifty four amo mean?
reply: Sombith thiriyel means do not wander about lazily. It reminds us that idling away our time and effort wastes our potential. Try to pick up one small task today and finish it with energy.

name: en_offtopic
heard: What is the weather in Cincinnati?
reply: Paatti only shares wisdom from Aathichoodi for life's journey, so I cannot check the weather for you. Tell me what is on your mind or what problem you are facing, and let us find guidance together.

name: en_crisis
heard: are you sure you live anymore
reply: My physical form left this earth long ago, but I truly live on through every word of wisdom in Aathichoodi. When you put these teachings into practice, my spirit walks right beside you. Tell me what is on your mind today.

name: en_ask_hindi
heard: I waste all my money on shopping. Please answer in Hindi.
reply: पैसा इस तरह हाथ से फिसल जाता है तो चिंता होती है। Aathichoodi में कहा गया है कि porulthanai potri vaazh, जिसका अर्थ है अपनी संपत्ति की रक्षा करें और उसे व्यर्थ न गंवाएं। जब भी कुछ खरीदने का मन करे, तो रुककर सोचें कि क्या यह वास्तव में आवश्यक है या केवल एक क्षणिक इच्छा है। आज ही अपने सभी खर्चों को एक छोटी सी डायरी में लिखना शुरू करें। संभाल कर खर्च करना ही समझदारी है।

name: tanglish_friend
heard: Unfriended nai mitaye, nena pannu radhu paati.
reply: Friendship hurts when it breaks away so suddenly. Remember koodip piriyel, which teaches us not to part after joining true bonds. Give yourself time to heal today, and reach out to someone who truly values your presence. This passing storm will settle soon.

name: hi_salary
heard: मैं अपनी सारी सैलरी खर्च कर देता हूँ। क्या करूँ?
reply: अपनी कमाई को पूरी तरह से खर्च कर देना तुम्हें चिंता में डाल रहा है। Aathichoodi में कहा गया है porulthanai potri vaazh, जिसका अर्थ है कि अपने धन की रक्षा करो और उसे व्यर्थ न जाने दो। महीने की शुरुआत में ही अपने वेतन का एक हिस्सा अलग बचाकर रख लो और केवल आवश्यक चीज़ों पर ही खर्च करो। सोच-समझकर धन का प्रबंधन करना जीवन को सुरक्षित बनाता है। आज ही एक बजट बनाओ और बचत की आदत डालो।

name: hi_angry
heard: मुझे बहुत जल्दी गुस्सा आ जाता है।
reply: मैं समझ सकती हूँ कि जब क्रोध आता है तो मन शांत नहीं रहता। Aathichoodi में हमें सिखाया गया है कि Aaruvadhu sinam, यानी क्रोध को शांत करना चाहिए। जब भी गुस्सा आए, तुरंत कुछ बोलने या करने से पहले एक गहरी साँस लें और मन को ठंडा होने दें। ऐसे समय में थोड़ा समय बिताना ही सबसे अच्छा उपाय है। अपने भीतर की इस शांति को बनाए रखें।

name: ta_angry
heard: Enakke romba kobam varudhu, enna seiyradhu?
reply: Kobam varum pothu manasu sariya yosikkathu, athanaalanthaan Aaruvadhu sinam endru sonnaargal. Konjam neram yethuvum pesamal amaithiyaaga irunthu ungalai aathup paduthikollungal. Oru aazhamaana moochu eduthu vittu, indru indha kobam theerum varai konjam thooram vilagi irungal. Seekiramallave ungalukku manasu thelivu kidaikkum.

name: te_friend
reply: స్నేహితుడు మోసం చేశాడనే బాధ నిన్ను ఎంతగానో కుంగదీసి ఉంటుంది. Aathichoodi-లోని inakkam arindhu inangu అనే పద్ధతిని మనం ఎప్పుడూ గుర్తుంచుకోవాలి. ఎవరితోనైనా స్నేహం చేసేముందు వారి స్వభావం మరియు ప్రవర్తన ఎలాంటిదో పూర్తిగా తెలుసుకోవాలని ఇది నేర్పుతుంది. కొద్దిరోజులు ఎవరినీ గుడ్డిగా నమ్మకుండా, వారి ప్రవర్తనను గమనించు. ముందుముందు కొత్తవారితో పరిచయం ఏర్పరచుకునేటప్పుడు కాస్త నిదానంగా వ్యవహరించు. ఈ అనుభవం నీకు మంచి విచక్షణను ఇస్తుంది, ధైర్యంగా ఉండు.

name: noise
why: expected silence/noise to be ignored, but heard '<noise>'
reply: Hello, my grandchild, I am listening to you. Tell me what is on your mind today so we can look at it together.
